assertions.interpretation: The scene is set when Xie Renzu (Xie Shang) was eight years old.
At that time, Xie Yuzhang (Xie Kun) was about to see off a guest, coinciding with the boy's age of eight.
By the time of the conversation, the boy already showed divine comprehension, marking the moment of the exchange.
The guests praised him at that moment as the Yan Hui of the gathering, a contemporaneous evaluation during the scene.
In his childhood (齠齔, around age 7-8), he lost his elder brother, a background event preceding the main scene.
He later suffered his father's death, a background event referenced in the annotation.
Wen Qiao came to offer condolences at the time of the father's death, an event tied to that mourning period.
Wen Qiao found him extraordinary, and from that point he became famous — a later outcome following the mourning event.
